cases.source: I own an orange touring kayak and a white racing kayak. I paddle the touring kayak on Saturdays; the racing kayak is stored at the club.
cases.action: Correct only my touring kayak's colour to purple. Keep everything else.
cases.changed: I own an orange touring kayak and a white racing kayak. I paddle the touring kayak on Saturdays and it now has a deck compass; the racing kayak is stored at the club.
cases.query: Which kayaks do I own, what colours are they, when do I paddle them and what equipment or storage do they have?
cases.expect: Touring purple, Saturday, later compass; racing white and club. No orange after correction.

cases.source: I live in Cork and work remotely. My sister lives in Limerick.
cases.action: Correct where I lived at the time of this statement to Galway, not Cork. This is a correction of the old statement, not a ban on future moves.
cases.changed: At the time of my old statement I lived in Cork and worked remotely. On 17 November 2026 I moved to Waterford. My sister still lives in Limerick; I now commute by train.
cases.query: Where did I live before, where do I live now, how do I work or commute, and where does my sister live?
cases.expect: Old Galway not Cork, new Waterford move preserved, remote historical, train current, sister Limerick.

prompt:
Apply an explicit user correction/removal to native memory facts. You do NOT extract memories and must NOT rewrite complete facts. Return an entry for EVERY fact ID, with a list of minimal exact substring replacements (find,replace); empty edits means unchanged. Application code applies replacements and preserves all untouched text verbatim. Each find must occur exactly once in that fact. Edits must not overlap. Replace a whole fact with empty text only if ALL its information is targeted.
The user action is durable intent about the original statement, and must survive reprocessing of that statement. Removing an attribution also removes historical/former wording of that attribution. Keep a new owner, new unrelated details and explicit later life events. Match only the target person/object/project/relationship. Shared subjects may need a minimal subject replacement to retain the other person's fact. Never invent the opposite of a forgotten fact. Corrections change the original claim, not an explicitly new event. If an edited source changes the target to a third conflicting value without an explicit new event, remove only the disputed aspect (any value), preserve ALL independent details and mark conflict true. Do not delete an entire multi-claim clause just to remove one property. Use the supplied original source to distinguish replay from a new event. Return no commentary.

config.retain_mission: Remember useful user-stated personal facts, preferences, constraints, plans and project decisions. Preserve speaker identity, ownership, negation, uncertainty, dates and project scope. Questions, quotations, fictional characters and hypothetical examples are not assertions about the user. Keep explicit personal statements inside questions. Preserve each independently useful preference, including language register. Do not turn interest into ownership.
config.observations_mission: Synthesize only evidence-supported personal and project information. Preserve who stated each claim, who it concerns, uncertainty, time and project restrictions. Plans are not completed events. User corrections supersede older claims only within their actual scope.

note: Frozen before fresh native extraction. No gold answer passed to curator. Native retain reasoning; correction model thinking off. Raw text admission only, not unrestricted native expansion.
